fields.Name: T269 - Lists Category Master Detail
fields.Description: Tests the category tree master-detail selection and per-category list/subcategory aggregation in lists-categories-resource — a distinct code path from the flat lists grid.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, select the Lists application, and open the 'Categories' section in its left nav. In the left 'Categories' tree panel, click a category node. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Success is that clicking a category populates the right-hand 'Category Details' panel — showing the category Name, its Parent Category (or '(Top Level)'), and the Lists / Subcategories stat counts. If there are no categories yet, the 'No Categories Yet' empty state rendering is also a valid success.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Categories tree lists at least one category node OR a valid 'No Categories Yet' empty state is shown
Selecting a category node fills the 'Category Details' panel with its Name, Parent Category value, and the Lists / Subcategories stat counts (member list names appear when the category has lists)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
